subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: If If a ledger file is structurally malformed such that entries or the derived-state region cannot be delimited, then the system shall report a named defect (which region could not be parsed) rather than crash or false-pass
intent: a named parse defect, nothing mutated
fit_criterion: on a malformed-ledger fixture, the affected arm reports a named parse defect and does not crash or emit a false green
